# hosttracker_maintenance_windows (Data Source)

Reads the account's maintenance windows, narrowed by the filters below. The filters are ANDed, and each list filter matches any of its values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The windows that have not happened yet.
data "hosttracker_maintenance_windows" "scheduled" {
  state = ["scheduled"]
}

# The windows covering one monitor, whichever state they are in.
data "hosttracker_maintenance_windows" "for_marketing" {
  monitor = [hosttracker_monitor.marketing.id]
}

# The windows starting inside one span. `from` and `to` bound the window's
# START, not its extent: a long window that began earlier is not matched.
data "hosttracker_maintenance_windows" "this_quarter" {
  from        = 1785712608
  to          = 1793488608
  max_results = 200
}

resource "hosttracker_monitor" "marketing" {
  type      = "http"
  url       = "https://example.com/"
  name      = "Marketing site"
  locations = { pools = ["allworld"] }
}

output "next_window_starts" {
  value = try(data.hosttracker_maintenance_windows.scheduled.windows[0].from_rfc3339, null)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `from` (Number) Keep only windows that START at or after this instant, in Unix seconds.
- `max_results` (Number) How many windows to collect across pages. Defaults to 1000. The data source walks the cursor itself and stops here.
- `monitor` (Set of String) Keep only windows covering these monitors, by id.
- `name` (String) Keep only windows with this display name, matched exactly.
- `state` (Set of String) Keep only windows in these states: `scheduled`, `active`, `finished`.
- `to` (Number) Keep only windows that START at or before this instant, in Unix seconds. It bounds the start, not the extent: a long window that began earlier is not matched by it.

### Read-Only

- `ids` (List of String) The matched windows' ids, in the order the API returned them.
- `windows` (Attributes List) The matched maintenance windows. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--windows))

<a id="nestedatt--windows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `windows`

Read-Only:

- `created` (Number) When the window was created, in Unix seconds.
- `duration_sec` (Number) How long it lasts, in seconds of real elapsed time.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the window is in force.
- `from` (Number) When the window opens, in Unix seconds.
- `from_rfc3339` (String) `from` rendered in UTC, for reading.
- `id` (String) The window's id.
- `monitor_ids` (Set of String) The monitors the window covers.
- `monitors` (Attributes Set) The coverage per monitor, with the suppression each one really carries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--windows--monitors))
- `name` (String) The display name.
- `overlimited` (Boolean) Whether the account's package has stopped the window from applying.
- `recurrence` (Attributes) How the window repeats, or absent for a one-time window. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--windows--recurrence))
- `state` (String) `scheduled`, `active` or `finished`.
- `suppress` (Attributes) What the window holds back, while every covered monitor agrees. Where they differ it is absent and the answer is in `monitors`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--windows--suppress))
- `timezone` (String) The zone the window's wall clock is read in.
- `to` (Number) When it closes, in Unix seconds.
- `to_rfc3339` (String) `to` rendered in UTC, for reading.
- `updated` (Number) When it last changed, in Unix seconds.

<a id="nestedatt--windows--monitors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `windows.monitors`

Read-Only:

- `monitor_id` (String) The monitor this entry is about.
- `suppress` (Attributes) What the window holds back for this monitor. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--windows--monitors--suppress))

<a id="nestedatt--windows--monitors--suppress"></a>
### Nested Schema for `windows.monitors.suppress`

Read-Only:

- `alerts` (Boolean) Whether its alerting is held back.
- `stats` (Boolean) Whether its checks are kept out of the statistics.



<a id="nestedatt--windows--recurrence"></a>
### Nested Schema for `windows.recurrence`

Read-Only:

- `week_days` (Set of String) The days it repeats on.


<a id="nestedatt--windows--suppress"></a>
### Nested Schema for `windows.suppress`

Read-Only:

- `alerts` (Boolean) Whether alerting is held back.
- `stats` (Boolean) Whether the checks are kept out of the statistics.
